title: TD2 Comms: Campus
summary: A collection of 8 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 8 entries include full audio transcripts; 8 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Quarantine Staff": Henry Hayes, the leader of the Campus settlement, tries to find out what happened to his wife, a nurse at the Roosevelt Island quarantine (Location: Downtown West (2257, 2290))

Comm "Food Scarcity": Henry Hayes, the leader of the Campus settlement, laments the food scarcity and is reassured that they will find a way to feed the community (Location: Downtown West (2183, 2047))
Comm "Building Community": Henry Hayes, the leader of the Campus settlement, announces the community and lays out a new plan of action (Location: Downtown West (2228, 1973))
Comm "Help Wanted": Henry Hayes, the leader of the Campus settlement, confides in another civilian that they need help (Location: Downtown West (2372, 2321))
Comm "Mystery Meat": A gardener serves stew to a reluctant civilian (Location: Constitution Hall (1697, 2309))
Comm "Grief Counseling": Henry Hayes gives advice and consoles one of the Campus civilians (Location: West End (2405, 1272))
Comm "Leader Elected": Henry Hayes gives a speech after being elected the leader of the Campus settlement (Location: Judiciary Square (2030, 4607))
Comm "Garden Tour": Henry Hayes gets a tour of the vegetable gardens at the Campus settlement, from one of the civilians (Location: Judiciary Square (2196, 4499))
